crossRefs.note: How long, Yahweh? Will you be angry forever? Will your jealousy burn like fire?
When its boughs are withered, they will be broken off. The women will come and set them on fire, for they are a people…
Tell the forest of the South, ‘Hear Yahweh’s word: The Lord Yahweh says, “Behold, I will kindle a fire in you, and it…
All flesh will see that I, Yahweh, have kindled it. It will not be quenched.” ’ ”
If a man doesn’t remain in me, he is thrown out as a branch and is withered; and they gather them, throw them into the…
When you rebuke and correct man for iniquity, you consume his wealth like a moth. Surely every man is but a breath.”
At your rebuke, God of Jacob, both chariot and horse are cast into a dead sleep.
You, even you, are to be feared. Who can stand in your sight when you are angry?
For we are consumed in your anger. We are troubled in your wrath.
who will pay the penalty: eternal destruction from the face of the Lord and from the glory of his might,

translations.web: It’s burned with fire. It’s cut down. They perish at your rebuke.
translations.bsb: Your vine has been cut down and burned; they perish at the rebuke of Your countenance.
translations.kjv: It is burned with fire, it is cut down: they perish at the rebuke of thy countenance.
translations.asv: It is burned with fire, it is cut down: They perish at the rebuke of thy countenance.
